title: Ecological effects and multi-factor synergistic driving mechanisms of antibiotic mixtures in aquatic–terrestrial transition zones
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW01085C, Paper
Bo Zhu, Tao Wang, Jian Huang, Hua Zhang, Mengyao Zheng, Chunhua He
An in-depth study of antibiotic mixtures in Chaohu Lake aquatic–terrestrial transition zones is presented. Tetracyclines were the most prevalent, algae faced higher ecological risks, and nutrients (TN, TP, and NH3-N) were key drivers.
